a: Chunk size balances context quality vs retrieval precision.
Vector DBs store embeddings for similarity search.
Cosine similarity measures angle between vectors.
Hybrid search combines keyword and vector retrieval.
Rerankers reorder retrieved candidates for better relevance.
Tool schemas describe functions the model can invoke.
Structured output constrains responses to JSON or schemas.
Evaluation harnesses run fixed tasks to track model quality.
Prompt injection tries to override system instructions via user content.
Grounding ties answers to retrieved or provided sources.
